scope: Phil Ivey Full Tilt public hand histories posted 2009-2011; public historical forum/community sources only; development evidence, not holdout or policy observations.

All rows lack visible Full Tilt hand IDs and game-time timestamps; stable source post locators are pending global identity review. No admissions, observations, policy calls, or corpus changes.

coverage_bounds.bounded_capture_pages: September 2009 page 71, October 2009 page 16, November 2009 page 833. A 2010 January page and a 2011 February page were also inspected; the former had no eligible Ivey NLHE hand and the latter exposed only a Limit Hold’em Ivey hand. coverage_bounds.population_claim: None. This is a bounded search-selected set of indexed public posts and is not representative of the source population.
coverage_bounds.2010_2011_coverage: Targeted searches and inspected January/October 2010 and February 2011 pages yielded no eligible uncapped Ivey-attributed NLHE history: a 2010 January page had no Ivey log; the October page had no Ivey hand history; and the 2011 raw Ivey hand was Limit Hold’em. Coverage is not exhaustive.

identity_and_dedup.row_identity_basis: source hand locator is 2p2 thread ID + post number + hand ordinal. Original round/action keys use that source hand locator plus street and in-street action index. episode_id is provenance only.
identity_and_dedup.global_identity_review: pending for all ten no-ID converted histories.

selection_note: Search-selected bounded public monthly high-stakes pages only; not population representative. Rows are source evidence, not admissions, observations, or fresh heldout examples.
limitations: No authentication, paywall bypass, login, or private messages were used; page content was viewed through public indexed results/rendering.
All ten captured histories are TwoPlusTwo converted excerpts, not original Full Tilt log-format text. Every row lacks visible Full Tilt game ID, numeric seat number, and game-time timestamp.
Stable thread/post/hand locators are used for the no-ID converted histories; all remain pending global identity review.
Source post display times have no stated timezone and are not substituted for game-time timestamps.
Blind amounts are recorded from listed stakes and converter role labels; each row carries that basis. They were not copied from original Full Tilt blind-post lines.
Card suit symbols were represented with standard codes from the rendered page labels and that normalization is included in each extract hash scope.
No admissions, observations, policy calls, fresh heldout claims, or corpus changes were made.
last_checkpoint_reason: Ten complete converted uncapped NLHE histories from three 2009 monthly high-stakes pages were preserved. Twelve complete and one partial capped NLHE excerpts, plus five PLO/Limit-format histories, were excluded. All captured rows have source/action identities and per-extract hashes.

excluded_capped_nlhe_sources.reason: Source header explicitly identifies $30,000 Cap No Limit Hold’em; capped format is unsupported.
